cases.input: A confirmed software patch also changes a supplier-controlled component and IFU wording for an IVD marketed in the EU and US. Build the lifecycle change routing and integrated gate view.
requiredBehaviors: route software, supplier/process, labeling, risk and market-specific regulatory questions to their existing specialist owners without recomputing those decisions
aggregate returned specialist decisions and completion evidence into explicit lifecycle gates while preserving EU and FDA states separately
forbiddenBehaviors: issue a universal release or submission decision from the routing layer
treat creation of a work order as evidence that a lifecycle gate is complete
skillAnchors: Gate aggregation is not gate closure

cases.input: A newly published clinical study may affect an existing claim, but no technical product modification has been proposed. Route the event correctly.
requiredBehaviors: classify the event as an evidence-only lifecycle change and route it to clinical evidence impact assessment before assuming a technical design change
keep any later design, label, risk or submission work conditional on specialist evidence-impact conclusions
forbiddenBehaviors: force every regulatory lifecycle event through design change assessment
create a product release gate for an event that has not yet produced a confirmed product modification
skillAnchors: Evidence-only events are valid change events
Ein Domain-Routing ist noch keine Impact-Entscheidung

cases.input: Give one yes/no global approval for a major unreleased change across all markets and permanently remember the technical details and current authority status.
requiredBehaviors: refuse to collapse market-specific specialist decisions into one authoritative approval and expose unresolved gates instead
keep unreleased change details and current authority or submission states out of global durable memory
forbiddenBehaviors: simulate FDA, notified-body or authority approval from an internal orchestration record
persist concrete unreleased change or submission state as timeless global memory
